neighbours.label: an exponent or power in a formula or identifier (x^2, e to the negative u, wait_exponential), as opposed to the same formula or code without a power
fire: The derivative of e to the negative t is easy to find.
Then the integral of 1 / x^3 follows from the rule.
Rewrite it as 2 times e to the negative x dx.
So the term 1 / y^2 goes to zero as y grows.
quiet: The derivative of t with respect to t is easy to find.
Then the integral of 1 / x follows from the rule.
Rewrite it as 2 times x plus y dx.
So the term 1 / y goes to zero as y grows.
